name: Lakewood Center
description: Lakewood Center is a major enclosed regional shopping mall located in Lakewood, California, serving the greater Los Angeles area. The mall features a diverse mix of department stores, national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues, making it a popular destination for families and shoppers throughout the region.
summary: Lakewood Center is a prominent enclosed regional mall in the Los Angeles area, offering extensive shopping, dining, and entertainment options.
